The receiver is rejecting the virtual file as a duplicate even though the sender has assigned a new, unique SFIDTIME. The earlier invoice (INV58105) was sent with SFIDTIME `0722110001`; the new invoice (INV58106) uses `0925060001`. Per RFC 5024 §1.5.2, the Dataset Name, Date, and Time together uniquely identify a virtual file. The receiver’s duplicate check appears to ignore the time component and is therefore incorrectly treating the second invoice on the same day as a duplicate of the first. The sender’s gateway trace shows the file was never previously transmitted from gw1, and the receiver never accepted it, so no duplicate virtual file was actually delivered. The fault lies with the receiver’s duplicate detection logic.
